hints.title: Sort the Collection
hints.text: Sort the array in ascending order to easily access the smallest and largest elements.

hints.title: Slice Subsets
hints.text: Sum the first k elements to find the minimum sum and the last k elements to find the maximum sum.

hints.title: Compute Difference
hints.text: Return the absolute difference between the sum of the k largest elements and the sum of the k smallest elements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting in place takes O(1) extra space or O(n) depending on Python Timsort.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for minimums and maximums without sorting costs O(k * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting provides direct index access to the k extremes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean concise implementation using sort or quickselect.
